root_cause: An HTML file referenced script.js and styles.css, but the plan created neither. The unresolved references were only detected by the coherence checker after the write, costing a full reject-and-retry cycle that the planner could have prevented.

details.rule: Every <link href>, <script src>, and CSS url() in a proposed file must resolve to a file the plan will produce. Validate the reference graph at plan time, not after the write. A reference to a not-yet-planned file is a planning error.
